Key variables include the timing and coverage of showers, which limit insolation, and boundary-layer humidity that caps afternoon rises. Updated model guidance expected overnight or early on the 17th will refine the exact maximum, while official observations from Shanghai’s urban stations will determine resolution. The tight clustering around 30–32 °C underscores the limited upside or downside risk given present atmospheric conditions.

Updated short-range guidance and any overnight convective trends will be the key near-term catalysts for shifts in these market-implied odds.

eventMetadata.context_description: Forecast models from the Finnish Meteorological Institute and international agencies indicate a maximum temperature near 20–21°C for Helsinki on August 17, aligning with the market's leading implied probabilities of 46% for 21°C and 36% for 20°C. Ankara's continental climate on the Anatolian plateau produces typical mid-August highs of 29–32°C, driven by peak solar insolation, regional high-pressure subsidence, and dry northerly flows that limit cloud cover and moisture. Recent observations show daytime maxima fluctuating between 25–29°C in mid-August, consistent with seasonal norms and without strong anomalies from teleconnections like ENSO. Short-range ensemble guidance indicates stable steering patterns through the 18th, with minimal model spread around the 30°C threshold—though minor shifts in boundary-layer mixing or timing of any weak frontal passage could nudge the peak to 29°C or 31°C. Resolution hinges on official Turkish State Meteorological Service observations, which prioritize the daily maximum reading.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 18 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/ph/manila/RPLL.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: The southwest monsoon (habagat) currently dominating Luzon has sustained cloudy skies and scattered showers over Metro Manila, suppressing peak daytime heating and aligning with PAGASA's 25–29°C range forecasts for August 18. This pattern, typical of the wet season, reduces solar insolation relative to the seasonal 30–31°C average and keeps most model guidance clustered near 28–29°C maxima. Trader consensus reflects these conditions through the combined 82% implied probability on those two bins, with lower odds on 30°C+ outcomes hinging on any unexpected monsoon break. Updated PAGASA briefings and model runs over the next 48 hours remain the key near-term catalysts.
